answer_1.quote: We evaluate five benchmarks: (1) RULER ... (4) FACTSCORE ... (5) CS4 ... FACTSCORE evaluates a model's ability to generate factual long-form biographies ... CS4 evaluates constrained creative story generation ...

answer_2.quote: We report VERISCORE as the factuality metric ... We use GPT‑4o to evaluate constraint satisfaction ... BooookScore evaluates the narrative quality based on language fluency, salience, internal consistency ...

answer_3.quote: We improve upon the evaluation prompt used in ..., employing GPT‑4o as the judge ... The judge model is prompted with three constraints at a time, and the results are then aggregated.

answer_4.quote: These 42 story‑constraint pairs were manually annotated by one of the authors, who independently read each story and assessed which constraints were satisfied.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators read each generated story and marked which of the listed constraints were satisfied.
